An example of a creature with a Crown Hunting symbol.
Hunting Quests
are a mechanic first introduced in March of 2016. Sometimes, an Adventurer will encounter a creature with a silver crown glowing over its head. Defeating this creature will grant the Adventurer a quest. Upon completion, the player receives experience points in their two active combat skills, plus xp in the related anatomy type. In addition, if the player uses
First Aid
and/or
Armor Patching
while completing the final (usually tenth) kill of a hunting quest, the combat xp from completing the quest will be awarded for those skills as well.

Serbule Hills
Hunting Quests
Hunting: Black Widow Spiders
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Black Widow Spiders
, which are are common across
Serbule Hills
.
+
Black Widow Spiders
are found throughout the entire region, except for directly around the Ranalon-controlled lakes.

Hunting: Deer
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of Deer in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Buck Deer
,
Doe Deer
, and the rarer
Rabid Deer
can be found in the region, usually on hillsides.
Kill Deer x10
Hunting: Fire Sheep
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Fire Sheep
, which are are a rare spawn in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Fire Sheep
are found predominately on hillsides and at the top of hills. The western edge of the region is a common place to find them, as are the hills in the southwest.
Kill Fire Sheep x5
Hunting: Goblins

Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Goblins
, which are are part of an invasion force encountered at encampments throughout the eastern half of
Serbule Hills
.
+

Camp Overseer
,
Competent Goblin
,
Goblin Archer
,
Goblin Archery Student
,
Goblin Guard
,
Goblin Lumberjack
,
Goblin Patrol
,
Goblin Scribe
,
Goblin Soldier
,
Goblin Spear Trainee
,
Goblin Spearman
,
Logging Camp Guard

Kill Goblins in Serbule Hills x10
Hunting: Guard Scrays
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Guard Scrays
, which are Ranalon-bred pets found throughout their encampments in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Guard Scrays
are found on the shores of the two Ranalon-controlled lakes, although occasionally a few may fly further north.
Kill Guard Scrays x8
Hunting: Pigs
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Pigs
, which are are common near farmland in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Pigs
are found primarily in the northern hills and western hills. Sometimes, pigs will be found near patches of farmland.
Kill Pigs x10
Hunting: Ranalon Gardeners
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Ranalon Gardeners
, a frequently encountered variety of Ranalon in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Ranalon Gardeners
are found both underwater in the two lakes, and on the beaches around them.
Kill Ranalon Gardeners x10
Hunting: Ranalon Stone Shapers
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Ranalon Stone-Shapers
, which are part o the hostile Ranalon invasion of
Serbule Hills
.
+
Ranalon Stone-Shapers
are found among the hills surrounding the two lakes.
Kill Ranalon Stoneshapers x6
Hunting: Rats
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of Rats, which are a common species encountered throughout
Serbule Hills
and the rest of Alharth.
+
Giant Plains Rats
are found throughout the entire region, especially in the northwest.
Kill Rats x10
Hunting: Sheep
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Valley Sheep
, unexpectedly dangerous denizens of
Serbule Hills
.
+
Valley Sheep
are found throughout the entire region, and can easily be found everywhere without extensive tree cover.
Kill Sheep x10
Hunting: Tigers
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Tigers
, which are are common across
Serbule Hills
.
+
Tigers
and
Sickly Tigers
are found in both the northern hills of the region and the eastern forestland.
Kill Tigers x10
Hunting: Wild Chickens
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Wild Chickens
, found around farmland in
Serbule Hills
.
+
Wild Chicken
are found predominantly near the farmlands and buildings in the northwest.
Kill Wild Chickens x6
Hunting: Wild Pigs
Kill Wild Pigs x10
Hunting: Worgs
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Worgs
, which are are usually uncommon, but often seen in the southern hills of
Serbule Hills
.
+
Worgs
are found primarily in the hills south of the two lakes, but can be occasionally seen in the northeast.
Kill Worgs x10

This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Cunning Wolves
, which are are common foes in
Eltibule
.
+
Cunning Wolves
are often encountered around the small lakes towards the center of the region, and in the eastern hills.
Kill Cunning Wolves x10
Hunting: Eltibule Bears
This
Hunting Quest
calls for the elimination of
Bears
, which are easily encountered in part of
Eltibule
.
+
Bear Groupies
are found only in the northeast, on a small hill surrounding the
Animal Handling
Cat Shrine.
Kill Bears in Eltibule x10
